description: Wave 31: luaClientManager stop/ensure race closed (sibling of the wave-2 spawn race). stopClient awaited the quit handshake before nulling this.client, so a concurrent ensureClient() saw the already-killing client as healthy and handed it to a tool call that used a bridge dying mid-request; stop-while-starting also orphaned the starting client (initClient assigned this.client after the stop read it). description: Wave 36: empty-vs-missing confusion in spec/item-set handlers. handleCreateSpec/DeleteSpec/RenameSpec keyed failure off result.specs.length — deleting down to the last spec, or a rename whose Lua list came back empty, was reported 'Failed to …' although the operation succeeded. listSpecs/listItemSets collapsed the last-remaining entry into 'No specs/item sets found. Load a build first.' Gates now test the response shape (Array.isArray) and emptiness is data. 4 fail-before/pass-after-style regression tests (rename case genuinely fails-before), 457 green.

description: Wave 37: TradeApiClient response cache was an unbounded Map — every distinct search/fetch accumulates entries for the process lifetime (TTL expiry only fires on read of that exact key; server lifetime is days). Now a 200-entry LRU: read refreshes recency (insertion-order Map trick), write evicts oldest. 2 fail-before/pass-after tests (260 puts → size 200, newest kept; hot entry survives eviction via read-refresh). 459 green.

description: Wave 38: tradeClient docstring claimed "Automatic retry with exponential backoff" but only 429 retried (via limiter hook honoring Retry-After) — one ECONNRESET or Cloudflare 502 surfaced straight to the tool user. makeRequest now attempts 1+maxRetries (default 3) with 500ms*2^n backoff for network/timeout/5xx; 4xx and 429 remain final (FinalApiError) so bad queries and rate limits keep their exact old semantics. Fresh AbortSignal.timeout(30s) per attempt (an expired signal reused across retries would fail instantly). 5 regression tests + live-API smoke (injected ECONNRESET -> retry -> 24 leagues). 464 green.

description: Wave 40: set_config enemyIsBoss legacy aliases + honest schema. PoB's own XML import maps Shaper/Sirus->Pinnacle and Uber Atziri->Boss (ConfigTab.lua:640-642); our set_config did not, so every caller of the documented example 'Shaper' got 'not a valid option for this list' while the same build file loads fine in the UI. pob_ops.lua now applies the identical mapping (the audit also verified list values are rejected-per-key rather than silently stored — coerceConfigValue validates against the option's accepted set, and handleSetConfig surfaces rejections). Schema now lists the real accepted set None/Boss/Pinnacle/Uber + the aliases. Live smoke assertion fail-before (exit 1)/pass-after against real PoB; 467 jest green.
